title: GLM provider uses actual GLM catalog with Claude env remap
content: The `glm` bro provider remains Claude-compatible at the CLI/protocol level, but its exposed brofile model catalog is the real GLM model set. Dispatch maps GLM model selection behind the scenes by setting `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` to the Z.AI Claude config root and overriding `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL`, `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL`, and `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` to the selected GLM model; when no brofile model is set, the provider default mapping is Haiku -> `glm-4.5-air`, Sonnet -> `glm-5-turbo`, Opus -> `glm-5.1`.
rationale: The Z.AI Claude tool is still the Claude CLI and expects Claude-shaped transport/model selection, but users want to reason about actual GLM backends and costs in brofiles. Exposing the real GLM catalog while remapping through Anthropic default-model env vars preserves the working Claude harness and gives truthful model selection at the orchestration layer.
